MAE's own official Xiaohongshu account (user 6332c7da000000002303f56e, redId maeglobal) also posts customer-result content with full, unobscured faces, one badged 真实顾客反馈 ('real customer feedback').

beforeAfter.publisher: Individual agents/distributors, plus MAE's official Xiaohongshu account. NOT maeglobalofficial.com.
beforeAfter.advice: DO NOT auto-import any of this. Three separate problems: (1) identifiable faces with no documented model release — personality-rights and PDPA exposure; (2) the mae(R) logo on agent-built templates makes unapproved material look brand-approved, so reusing it launders an agent's claim into MAE's voice; (3) the hard numbers ('RECOVER UP TO 98%', '100%有效絕不反彈') are agent-authored, not corporate, and are the kind of quantified efficacy claim Malaysian advertising rules treat harshly. Xiaohongshu CDN URLs also carry a timestamp path segment and expire, so they are not stable assets even setting the ethics aside.
